title: robot.villas feeds configuration
description: Configuration for robot.villas bots, follows, relays, and blocked instances.

meta.description: Enable @meta to announce new bot accounts. Reserves the username meta.

bots.description: Bot definitions keyed by fediverse username.

propertyNames.description: Bot username must be lowercase alphanumeric or underscore.

follows.description: Fediverse handles that every bot follows on startup.

relays.description: ActivityPub relay actor URLs to subscribe to. HTTP(S), without credentials.

relay_subscription_bot.description: The one bot that follows each relay; must be a key in `bots`. Defaults to the first bot.

blocked_instances.description: Hostnames refused in both directions; a domain also blocks its subdomains. Merged with BLOCKED_INSTANCES.

feed_url.description: RSS or Atom feed URL. HTTP(S), without credentials.

profile_photo.description: Profile photo URL. HTTP(S), without credentials.

homepage_url.description: Homepage URL for the site being mirrored. HTTP(S), without credentials.

default_hashtags.description: Up to three default hashtags without leading #.
